message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the facts and determine which crimes are directly supported.

Facts: Defendant bought a vehicle for 12,000 RMB, which was actually stolen (value 28,000). He knew it was stolen property (or at least the prosecution says he knew). He purchased it, i.e., concealed/hidden criminal proceeds. The charge is "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得罪" (concealing/covering up criminal proceeds). Under Chinese Criminal Law, that is Article 311 (concealing or hiding criminal proceeds). So the crime is "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得罪". Also possibly "非法买卖赃物" but that is covered under same article. The fact does not show theft, only purchase. So only that crime.

Thus answer: [罪名]掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得罪<eoa>
